title: Miss Your Old House And You Turn Its COLORS 🏠
premise: In our town, if you miss your old house you slowly turn its colors and never see it on yourself, so after a move a seventeen-year-old checks his mom's hands every morning and puts the old house back for her.
twist: The one going sky blue with yellow stripes is me, the teen who dodges every hug, and a hug from home is what washes it out.
world: Mom's sunny new kitchen across town, a back porch with the old house's sky-blue swing, the neighbor's porch over a white fence, and a street where people turn their old houses' colors.
